verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "10-day mission" (R2, R5, R6, R8, R9); "MISSION DURATION 9 Days, 1 Hour, 32 Minutes" approx. 10 days (R4); "Mission duration9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes" (R3); "approximately 10-day mission" (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly describe Artemis II as a roughly 10-day crewed test mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "testing the Orion spacecraft" (R1); "check that the spacecraft can safely make the journey" (R2); "validate the Orion spacecraft's systems... in deep space" (R3); "test flight of... the Orion spacecraft" (R5); "confirm all of the spacecraft's systems operate... in the deep space environment" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state validation/testing of Orion in deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate SLS rocket in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "evaluating the performance of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket along with the Orion spacecraft... in deep space" (R3); "test flight of... the SLS rocket, and the Orion spacecraft" (R5); "test the most powerful rocket NASA has ever built" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: R3 explicitly includes SLS validation in deep space; others confirm SLS testing during mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "checking out the key systems aboard Orion, including life support" (R2); "test essential life support systems" (R3); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5); "validate the life-support and environmental control systems" (R6); "demonstrate life support systems for the first time with crew" (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions of testing life-support systems in deep space context.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed trip around the moon in more than 50 years" (R1); "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972" (R3); "first crewed Lunar Flyby in 50 Years" (R4); "first time in over 50 years" (R5, R6)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm first crewed lunar mission since Apollo ~50+ years.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft" around moon (R1); "lifting four astronauts toward space... around the moon" (R2); "Crew size4" lunar flyby (R3); "fly four astronauts around the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistent across sources: four astronauts on lunar flyby.

verifications.claim: A key objective of Artemis II is testing the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test essential life support systems aboard the spacecraft" with crew (R3); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated as key objective.

verifications.claim: A key objective of Artemis II is testing the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "life support and other critical spacecraft systems" (R3); "life-support and environmental control systems" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Environmental control is part of life-support testing mentioned broadly.

verifications.claim: A key objective of Artemis II is testing the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Guidance, navigation, and communications" (R8); "navigation... systems" tests (R3 context)
verifications.reasoning: Sources include navigation testing in deep space with crew.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts... around the moon" (R1); "four astronauts... lunar round trip" (R2); "Crew size4... Crewed lunar flyby" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II journey passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond the Moon.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "fly within about 4,000 miles above the surface" (R2); "Distance4,067 mi" closest approach (R3); "over 4,000 miles beyond the Moon" (R5); "4,000 and 6,000 miles" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Closest approach ~4,000-4,100 miles; 4,700 is roughly in 4k-6k range but not precise.

verifications.claim: The four Artemis II astronauts include the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ms. Koch... will be the first woman to do so" (R2); "Christina Koch the first woman" beyond LEO (R3); "Koch will be the first woman to go to the Moon" i.e., beyond LEO (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly states Koch as first woman beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: The four Artemis II astronauts include the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Glover... first Black man to venture into deep space" (R2); "Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Direct attribution to Glover.

verifications.claim: The four Artemis II astronauts include the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Hansen... will be the first person on a moon mission who is not an American" (R2); "Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen the first non-U.S. citizen" beyond LEO (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly Hansen as first Canadian beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "set the mark for the farthest that anyone has ever traveled from Earth" (R2); "set the record for human distance from Earth" (R3); "farther from Earth than any humans have traveled before" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm new distance record.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis III.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test flight supporting subsequent Artemis missions" incl. III (R3); "preparing for Artemis III" (R6); "readiness for... Artemis 3" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Explicit preparation for Artemis III.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis IV.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "supporting subsequent Artemis missions" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Prepares for overall program including IV, but not specifically highlighted.

verifications.claim: Artemis III will land humans on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Artemis III →" landing implied; "Artemis III, which aims to land astronauts on the Moon" (R6); "Artemis 3, which will land on the surface of the moon" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Artemis III as lunar landing mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis IV will land humans on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Artemis IV associated with Gateway, not landing; Artemis III is landing (R3 context)
verifications.reasoning: Artemis III is the landing mission; IV focuses on Gateway/orbit.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "commander Reid Wiseman" (R2, R3); "Commander: Reid Wiseman" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed as commander.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "pilot Victor Glover" (R1, R2); "pilot Victor Glover" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed as pilot.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Christina Koch" mission specialist (R2, R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Jeremy Hansen" mission specialist (R2, R3, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed.
